fact: Togo's national agency states that its cybersecurity law No. 2018-026 of 7 December 2018, amended by law No. 2022-009 of 24 June 2022, and data protection law No. 2019-014 of 29 October 2019 were adopted taking account of the international conventions it lists, including the Malabo Convention.
title: Etat des lieux de la cybercriminalité au Togo 2023
